hypothesis: In some types of non-Alzheimer's, non-aged human brain cells, APOE4 disruption of lipid metabolism, compared with APOE3, results in impaired late endosome/lysosome function.

findings.description: Filipin III free-cholesterol intensity is higher in APOE4 than isogenic APOE3 hiPSC astrocytes.
findings.quote: we found a significant accumulation of cholesterol in ApoE4 astrocytes compared with ApoE3 astrocytes (Figures 4A and 4B)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more cellular free cholesterol in astrocytes)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. Filipin III imaging.

findings.description: The extra cholesterol sits mainly in lysosomes: the LysoTracker-overlapping share of filipin signal is higher in APOE4 than APOE3.
findings.quote: which was predominantly observed in lysosomes (Figures 4A and 4C)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more cholesterol retained in lysosomes)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. Filipin III with LysoTracker co-staining.

findings.description: LysoTracker-positive lysosomal area is larger in APOE4 than APOE3 astrocytes, while mitochondrial area is unchanged.
findings.quote: We repeatedly observed an increased lysosomal area, although the mitochondrial area was indistinguishable in ApoE4 astrocytes compared with ApoE3 cells (Figures 3A-3C)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (larger acidic lysosomal compartment)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. LysoTracker/MitoTracker imaging.

findings.description: Individual lysosomes are larger in APOE4 than APOE3 astrocytes.
findings.quote: We observed an increase in the size of lysosomes in ApoE4 astrocytes (Figures 3E and 3F)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (enlarged lysosomes)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. LysoTracker puncta size distribution.

findings.description: CONTRADICTING on lysosomal function: cathepsin B activity is about 50 percent HIGHER in APOE4 than APOE3 astrocytes, the opposite direction to the impaired-lysosome half of the hypothesis. Other papers report lower cathepsin B activity with APOE4 (e.g. P5.F2, Neuro-2a cells), so the direction differs between systems.
findings.quote: ApoE4 astrocytes displayed an approximately 50% increase in cathepsin B activity compared with ApoE3 astrocytes (Figure 3H)
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more lysosomal cathepsin B activity, not less)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. Fluorometric cathepsin B activity assay.

findings.description: p62 and LC3 puncta are increased in APOE4 astrocytes, read as autophagosomes accumulating because autolysosomal degradation is impaired. Read off the bars: p62 puncta about 51 vs 11 per cell (*, Fig 3J; effect and P recorded for this panel), LC3 puncta about 38 vs 12 (**, Fig 3K).
findings.quote: We observed that both p62 and LC3 levels were significantly increased in ApoE4 astrocytes compared with those in ApoE3 astrocytes (Figures 3I-3K)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more p62 and LC3 puncta -> less autolysosomal degradation)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. p62/LC3 immunostaining.

findings.description: Tandem RFP-GFP-LC3 shows more autophagosomes, fewer autolysosomes and lower autophagy flux in APOE4 than APOE3 astrocytes.
findings.quote: We observed increased autophagosomes (RFP and GFP) and decreased autolysosomes (RFP only) in ApoE4 astrocytes compared with ApoE3 astrocytes, indicating impaired autophagy flux (Figures 3L-3O)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower autophagy flux, fewer autolysosomes)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. RFP-GFP-tandem LC3 reporter imaging.

findings.description: Lipid-to-lysosome link: depleting lysosomal cholesterol with methyl-beta-cyclodextrin for 4 days normalizes LysoTracker intensity in APOE4 astrocytes toward APOE3 levels. The recorded P is the figure's star for APOE4 versus APOE3 (ANOVA with Dunnett's test against APOE3; the comparison group was confirmed by a human checker, since the legend does not name it). It establishes the phenotype being rescued; the treated APOE4 group carries no star, i.e. it no longer differs from APOE3. No P value is given for treated versus untreated APOE4, so the effect (rescue size) and the P (APOE4 vs APOE3) refer to different comparisons. Effect read off Fig 4F: LysoTracker intensity about 65 in APOE4 vs 48 with MbCD (APOE3 about 50).
findings.quote: We further observed restoration of lysosomal activity, as indicated by the mitigated intensity of LysoTracker after lysosomal cholesterol depletion (Figures 4D and 4F)
findings.summary: (APOE4 + cholesterol depletion) -> (LysoTracker phenotype normalized) -> lipid mediation
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. MbetaCD 100 uM, 4 d; LysoTracker intensity.

findings.description: A second cholesterol-lowering route, simvastatin, also normalizes the APOE4 increases in lysosomal cholesterol and LysoTracker area. The recorded P is the figure's star for APOE4 versus APOE3 (ANOVA with Dunnett's test against APOE3; the comparison group was confirmed by a human checker, since the legend does not name it). It establishes the phenotype being rescued; the treated APOE4 group carries no star, i.e. it no longer differs from APOE3. No P value is given for treated versus untreated APOE4, so the effect (rescue size) and the P (APOE4 vs APOE3) refer to different comparisons. Effect read off Fig 4I: LysoTracker area about 3.0 in APOE4 vs 0.75 with simvastatin (APOE3 1.0).
findings.quote: Simvastatin treatment also normalized ApoE4-dependent increases in lysosomal cholesterol accumulation and LysoTracker-positive areas in astrocytes (Figures 4G-4I)
findings.summary: (APOE4 + statin) -> (lysosomal cholesterol and LysoTracker area normalized)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. Simvastatin; filipin III and LysoTracker imaging.

findings.description: Methyl-beta-cyclodextrin restores autolysosome and autophagosome areas in APOE4 astrocytes. The recorded P is the figure's star for APOE4 versus APOE3 (ANOVA with Dunnett's test against APOE3; the comparison group was confirmed by a human checker, since the legend does not name it). It establishes the phenotype being rescued; the treated APOE4 group carries no star, i.e. it no longer differs from APOE3. No P value is given for treated versus untreated APOE4, so the effect (rescue size) and the P (APOE4 vs APOE3) refer to different comparisons. Effect read off Fig 5B: autophagosome percentage about 48 in APOE4 vs 36 with MbCD (APOE3 about 34).
findings.quote: We observed the restoration of autolysosomes and autophagosome areas in ApoE4 astrocytes with MbCD treatment, suggesting normalized autophagy flux (Figures 5A-5D)
findings.summary: (APOE4 + cholesterol depletion) -> (autophagy flux restored)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (GLAST-sorted): APOE4/4 line from an AD patient vs its CRISPR-corrected APOE3/3 isogenic line. MbetaCD; RFP-GFP-LC3 reporter.

findings.description: Replication in a second isogenic pair from a healthy donor (APOE3 edited to APOE4): autophagy flux is lower in APOE4 astrocytes; the partial recovery with cyclodextrin is not marked significant.
findings.quote: ApoE4 astrocytes displayed impaired autophagy flux compared with their isogenic ApoE3 cells, and this effect was attenuated by MbCD treatment (Figures S6F-S6I)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower autophagy flux), rescued by cholesterol depletion
findings.system: Second isogenic APOE3/APOE4 hiPSC-astrocyte pair (healthy APOE3 donor); RFP-GFP-LC3 with or without MbetaCD.

findings.description: Lysosomal proteolysis (DQ-BSA cleavage by flow cytometry) is reduced in APOE4/4 versus isogenic APOE3/3 astrocytes in both donor pairs.
findings.quote: APOE4/4 astrocytes showed significantly reduced lysosomal DQ-BSA signal compared to isogenic control APOE3/3 astrocytes across two isogenic donor pairs (Donor #1: p= 0.0032; Donor #2: p < 0.0001, Figure 4d), indicating decreased lysosomal proteolytic activity
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less lysosomal proteolysis)
findings.system: Isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes from two donors (APOE3/3 lines CRISPR-edited to APOE4/4), astrocyte monoculture. DQ-BSA Green, 24 h.

findings.description: After normalizing DQ-BSA to co-internalized dextran, APOE4/4 astrocytes still show lower proteolysis, so the deficit is per lysosome and not only fewer lysosomes.
findings.quote: Even after dextran normalization, APOE4/4 astrocytes retained significantly lower proteolytic activity (p = 0.0098; Figure S4e), indicating functional impairment rather than solely reduced lysosome abundance
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less proteolysis per lysosome)
findings.system: Isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes from two donors (APOE3/3 lines CRISPR-edited to APOE4/4), astrocyte monoculture. DQ-BSA normalized to dextran.

findings.description: LAMP1 immunoreactivity (lysosomal mass) is reduced in APOE4/4 astrocytes in both donor pairs.
findings.quote: Consistent with this, immunoreactivity for the lysosomal membrane protein LAMP1 was also significantly reduced in APOE4/4 astrocytes compared to isogenic APOE3/3 astrocytes (Donor #1: p = 0.0002 and Donor #2: p = 0.0001, Figure S4d)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less LAMP1, lower lysosomal mass)
findings.system: Isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes from two donors (APOE3/3 lines CRISPR-edited to APOE4/4), astrocyte monoculture. LAMP1 immunostaining.

findings.description: Lipid arm: BODIPY-cholesterol accumulates more in APOE4/4 than APOE3/3 astrocytes from two donors.
findings.quote: Consistent with altered lipid metabolism, APOE4/4 astrocytes showed significantly increased BODIPY-cholesterol accumulation compared to isogenic APOE3/3 astrocytes generated from two different individuals (Donor #1: p = 0.001; Donor #2: p = 0.002, Figure 5a)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more cellular cholesterol)
findings.system: Isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes from two donors (APOE3/3 lines CRISPR-edited to APOE4/4), astrocyte monoculture. BODIPY-cholesterol live imaging. Lipid readout only in this panel, no lysosomal readout.

findings.description: Lipid-to-lysosome link: cyclodextrins raise lysosomal proteolysis in APOE4/4 astrocytes, while atorvastatin, efavirenz and two LXR agonists do not, so not every cholesterol-lowering route helps.
findings.quote: Treatment with 2-hydroxypropyl-β-cyclodextrin (2HβCD) and methyl-β-cyclodextrin (MβCD) significantly increased lysosomal proteolysis (2HβCD: p = 0.0002; MβCD: p = 0.019) (Figure 5b), whereas the other interventions had neutral or negative effects on APOE4/4 lysosomal proteolytic activity (Figure 5b)
findings.summary: (APOE4 + cholesterol extraction) -> (lysosomal proteolysis increased); statin and LXR agonists -> no gain
findings.system: Isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes from two donors (APOE3/3 lines CRISPR-edited to APOE4/4), astrocyte monoculture. DQ-BSA Red over 24 h, small-molecule panel.

findings.description: The cyclodextrin gain in lysosomal proteolysis replicates in astrocytes from the second donor.
findings.quote: Increased lysosomal proteolytic activity with MβCD was replicated in astrocytes from a second donor (p = 0.0045; Figure S5c)
findings.summary: (APOE4 + MbetaCD) -> (lysosomal proteolysis increased), second donor
findings.system: Isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes from two donors (APOE3/3 lines CRISPR-edited to APOE4/4), astrocyte monoculture. Donor 2, DQ-BSA.

findings.description: Cyclodextrin increases LysoTracker-positive signal in APOE4/4 astrocytes. Note the baseline direction here is opposite to Lee 2023, where APOE4 raised LysoTracker signal.
findings.quote: Consistent with improved lysosomal capacity, MβCD increased LysoTracker-positive lysosomal signal in APOE4/4 astrocytes (p = 0.044; Figure 5d)
findings.summary: (APOE4 + MbetaCD) -> (more LysoTracker-positive lysosomes)
findings.system: Isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes from two donors (APOE3/3 lines CRISPR-edited to APOE4/4), astrocyte monoculture. LysoTracker imaging.

findings.description: Free cholesterol by filipin is higher in APOE4/4 astrocytes and is lowered by cyclodextrin to APOE3/3 levels. The P value is for the cyclodextrin reduction.
findings.quote: Filipin staining revealed a significant increase in endogenous free cholesterol in APOE4/4 astrocytes compared to APOE3/3 astrocytes, which was significantly reduced following MβCD treatment (p = 0.0167) to levels comparable to APOE3/3 astrocytes (Figure S5b)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more free cholesterol), reversed by MbetaCD
findings.system: Isogenic iPSC-derived astrocytes from two donors (APOE3/3 lines CRISPR-edited to APOE4/4), astrocyte monoculture. Filipin staining.

findings.description: Lysosomal free cholesterol (filipin colocalized with endocytosed TRITC-dextran) is 3-fold higher in APOE4 than APOE3 isogenic astrocytes.
findings.quote: Filipin and TRITC-Dextran co-localization (yellow puncta), a measure of lysosomal cholesterol (Majumdar et al., 2007), was significantly increased (3-fold, p<0.001) in APOE4 compared to APOE3 astrocytes, indicating that intracellular free cholesterol accumulates in lysosomes (Figure 6H)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lysosomal cholesterol sequestration)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (CRISPR-edited APOE3/APOE4 pairs, Indiv1 and Indiv2, same APOE haplotype). Filipin plus endocytosed TRITC-dextran imaging.

findings.description: Lipid arm: total cholesterol is 20 percent higher in APOE4 astrocytes, from the free cholesterol pool rather than cholesteryl esters.
findings.quote: Isogenic APOE4 astrocytes showed 20% increased total cholesterol, derived from a free cholesterol pool but not cholesteryl esters (CE) compared to APOE3 as measured by Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) (Muller et al., 2019) (Figure 6A)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more free cholesterol)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (CRISPR-edited APOE3/APOE4 pairs, Indiv1 and Indiv2, same APOE haplotype). GC-MS sterol quantification. Lipid readout only in this panel.

findings.description: LAMP1 and LAMP2, which act in the NPC2-to-NPC1 route that exports cholesterol out of the lysosome, are lower in APOE4 astrocytes (mRNA, Fig S6F) and microglia (LAMP1 protein, Fig S6E, p < 0.05), a candidate mechanism for the lysosomal cholesterol trapping.
findings.quote: Levels of LAMP1/2, which are involved in NPC2 to NPC1 cholesterol export pathway from lysosome were decreased in APOE4 astrocytes and microglia (Figures S6E and S6F)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less LAMP1/2 -> impaired lysosomal cholesterol export)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes and microglia; LAMP1/LAMP2 protein levels.

findings.description: Transcriptome: lysosome genes (e.g., LAMP1/2, NPC1/2, SMPD1, LIPA) are downregulated in APOE4 versus APOE3 population hiPSC microglia. In the Ingenuity analysis of the Lysosome pathway (Table S2), catabolism of lipid is predicted decreased (activation z = -2.764, p = 4.17E-16) and accumulation of cholesterol predicted increased (z = 2.765, p = 9.53E-10).
findings.quote: Downregulated DEGs in Lysosome (e.g., LAMP1/2, NPC1/2, SMPD1 and LIPA) predicts enhanced cholesterol accumulation, decreased lipid clearance and catabolism
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (lower lysosomal gene expression -> predicted cholesterol accumulation)
findings.system: Population (non-isogenic) hiPSC-derived microglia from APOE4 vs APOE3 carriers; RNA-seq with fGSEA and causal network analysis. Transcript surrogate only.

findings.description: Functional consequence of the lysosomal trapping: cholesterol efflux to methyl-beta-cyclodextrin is reduced in APOE4 astrocytes.
findings.quote: APOE4 astrocytes also exhibited reduced cholesterol efflux in the presence of 2% HDL and the cholesterol chelator methyl-β-cyclodextrin (MBCD), a measure of the total available cholesterol in the plasma membrane using fluorescently-labeled cholesterol (Figure 6L)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less cholesterol efflux)
findings.system: Isogenic hiPSC-derived astrocytes (CRISPR-edited APOE3/APOE4 pairs, Indiv1 and Indiv2, same APOE haplotype). Fluorescent cholesterol efflux assay, 6 h. Lipid readout only.

findings.description: CONTRADICTING: lysosomal activity is equally low in APOE3 and APOE4 iAstrocytes (both below APOE2 and APOE-knockout), so no APOE4-specific impairment relative to APOE3 in this assay.
findings.quote: Lysosomal activity in APOE3 and APOE4 was significantly lower than in APOE2 and APOE-KO cells (KO = E2 > E3 = E4) (Figure 4F)
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in lysosomal activity)
findings.system: Isogenic APOE2/E3/E4/knockout iPSC-derived astrocytes (EBiSC lines from one donor), quiescent, serum-free protocol. Lysosomal activity assay normalized to APOE3.

findings.description: CONTRADICTING: lysosome and endosome compartment area show no genotype difference by LAMP2 or dextran imaging; RAB5 endosomes are also unchanged.
findings.quote: Immunofluorescent detection of lysosomes by LAMP2 (Figure 4C) or Dextran-Alexa 555 (Figure S3) showed no difference between genotypes
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in lysosomal compartment area)
findings.system: Isogenic APOE2/E3/E4/knockout iPSC-derived astrocytes (EBiSC lines from one donor), quiescent, serum-free protocol. LAMP2 immunostaining, percent of cell area.

findings.description: LAMP2 protein by western blot is lower in APOE4 than APOE3, but APOE2 and the knockout are equally low, so the effect is not specific to APOE4.
findings.quote: However, protein levels of LAMP2 detected by western blot were significantly higher in APOE3 compared with APOE2, APOE4, and APOE-KO (E3 > E2 = E4 = KO) (Figures 4D and 4E)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less LAMP2 protein), not APOE4-specific
findings.system: Isogenic APOE2/E3/E4/knockout iPSC-derived astrocytes (EBiSC lines from one donor), quiescent, serum-free protocol. Western blot normalized to beta-actin.

findings.description: Lipid arm: non-membrane-bound free cholesterol is increased in APOE4 iAstrocytes above all other genotypes (Filipin III intensity about 1.8 in APOE4 vs 1.0 in APOE3; three experiments, 7-10 images per line per experiment).
findings.quote: We found that non-membrane-bound cholesterol was increased in APOE4 iAstrocytes (E4 > E3 = E2 = KO) (Figure 3F)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more intracellular free cholesterol)
findings.system: Isogenic APOE2/E3/E4/knockout iPSC-derived astrocytes (EBiSC lines from one donor), quiescent, serum-free protocol. MbetaCD wash then filipin III. Lipid readout only.

findings.description: NO DIFFERENCE versus APOE3 on lysosomal cholesterol: Filipin III / dextran colocalization is highest in APOE4 (about 1.25 vs 1.0 in APOE3), but the only significant comparison is APOE4 versus APOE2 (Kruskal-Wallis, *); APOE4 versus APOE3 carries no mark, so for the hypothesis's own comparison this is a null result.
findings.quote: Further colocalization of Filipin III with Dextran-Alexa 555 was highest in APOE4 iAstrocytes, indicating higher cholesterol levels in lysosomes of APOE4 iAstrocytes (E4 > E2) (Figure 3G)
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no significant change in lysosomal cholesterol; higher only vs APOE2)
findings.system: Isogenic APOE2/E3/E4/knockout iPSC-derived astrocytes (EBiSC lines from one donor), quiescent, serum-free protocol. Filipin III and Dextran-Alexa 555 colocalization.

findings.description: Lipid arm: cellular triacylglycerol, the main lipid droplet component, rises with APOE genotype in the order E4 > E3 > E2 = knockout; only the comparisons with knockout are marked significant, not E4 versus E3.
findings.quote: TAGs show a genotype-dependent increase both at baseline and after activation, with lowest cellular TAG levels in APOE-KO and highest in APOE4 iAstrocytes (Figures S2A and S5A)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more triacylglycerol / lipid droplets)
findings.system: Isogenic APOE2/E3/E4/knockout iPSC-derived astrocytes (EBiSC lines from one donor), quiescent, serum-free protocol. HPTLC lipid profiling of cell pellets. Lipid readout only.

findings.description: Lipid arm, direction differs from accumulation: by HPTLC lipid quantification, total cholesterol is about half in APOE4 versus APOE3 iAstrocytes (about 3.2 vs 6.2, normalized to phosphatidylcholine), with lower efflux and lower biosynthesis, while the same paper finds more free cholesterol in lysosomes (Fig 3F-G). The authors read this as dysregulated cholesterol homeostasis with cholesterol relocated into lysosomes. H5 requires disrupted lipid metabolism, not accumulation, so this is recorded as a lipid disruption, not a contradiction; it does disagree with the higher total cholesterol reported in other APOE4 astrocyte papers.
findings.quote: In line with the proteomic data, total as well as cellular and secreted cholesterol was decreased in APOE4 compared with APOE3 and APOE2 iAstrocytes, while showing similar levels to APOE-KO (E2 = E3 > E4 = KO) (Figures 3D, S2A, and S2B)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less total, cellular and secreted cholesterol: disrupted cholesterol homeostasis)
findings.system: Isogenic APOE2/E3/E4/knockout iPSC-derived astrocytes (EBiSC lines from one donor), quiescent, serum-free protocol. HPTLC lipid quantification. Lipid readout only.

findings.description: Lysosomes are alkalinized in APOE4-expressing neuronal cells: ratiometric dextran pH 5.86 versus 4.30 for APOE3. Note: the published legend key is garbled ("*p < .05, ****p < .01, *p < .0001"); read as a typo for the standard key (* < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001, **** < 0.0001).
findings.quote: We found that HsAPOE4-expressing cells exhibit dramatic lysosomal alkalinization (pH = 5.86) compared to HsAPOE3 (pH = 4.30) cells (Figure 1C-E), reminiscent of previous results in APOE4-expressing astrocyte lysosomes (pH = 5.20, compared to pH = 4.08 in APOE3 astrocytes) [26]
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (higher lysosomal pH -> impaired lysosomal function)
findings.system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells stably expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 (not human cells); isogenic apart from the APOE transgene. OregonGreen-dextran ratiometric lysosomal pH.

findings.description: Lysosomal proteolysis is reduced in APOE4 cells: Magic Red cathepsin B cleavage is lower, in line with the higher lysosomal pH. Note: the published legend key is garbled ("*p < .05, ****p < .01, *p < .0001"); read as a typo for the standard key (* < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001, **** < 0.0001).
findings.quote: We found that the HsAPOE4-expressing cells exhibited significantly decreased MR-CTSB proteolysis compared to HsAPOE3-expressing cells, in line with their decreased lysosomal acidity (Figure 1F,G)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less cathepsin B proteolysis)
findings.system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells stably expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 (not human cells); isogenic apart from the APOE transgene. Magic Red cathepsin B live imaging.

findings.description: LysoTracker signal is reduced in APOE4 cells while LAMP1 lysosomal density is not, so the loss of acidic signal reflects alkalinization rather than fewer lysosomes. Note: the published legend key is garbled ("*p < .05, ****p < .01, *p < .0001"); read as a typo for the standard key (* < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001, **** < 0.0001).
findings.quote: We found that the LysoTracker intensity was significantly reduced in HsAPOE4-expressing cells (Figure 1A,B), suggesting either endolysosomal alkalinization or a reduction in endolysosomal density
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less LysoTracker signal, lysosomes less acidic)
findings.system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells stably expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 (not human cells); isogenic apart from the APOE transgene. LysoTracker Deep Red imaging.

findings.description: Lipid-related mechanism: LysoIP proteomics finds lipid and glycan regulators, including the long-chain fatty acid ligase ACSL4 and the phosphoinositide phosphatase SACM1L, accumulating in APOE4 lysosomes alongside APOE itself. Values are for ACSL4 from Supplementary Table S1E (LysoIP, HsAPOE4 vs HsAPOE3): log2 fold change 2.13 (4.4x), -log10 P 2.04 (P = 0.0092); n = 3 untreated tagged replicates per genotype (Table S1D).
findings.quote: we found that HsAPOE4-expressing lysosomes accumulated APOE itself, AD-associated secretase proteins (PSEN2, CD63, TSPAN3), trafficking receptors (AP1S1, AP1G1, BET1L, LAMTOR1, LAMTOR2, TMED5), and lipid/glycan-regulators (ACSL4, ACBD3, GALNT2, MAN2B1, NEU1, PIP4P1, SACM1L, PIP4P1/TMEM55B, UXS1) (Figure 3B,C, Figure S3C)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (remodeled lysosomal proteome including lipid-handling proteins)
findings.system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells stably expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 (not human cells); isogenic apart from the APOE transgene. LysoIP (TMEM192-3xHA) lysosomal proteomics.

findings.description: Causal test of the driver: knocking down TMED5 re-acidifies lysosomes in APOE4 cells without changing lysosomal density. Note: the published legend key is garbled ("*p < .05, ****p < .01, *p < .0001"); read as a typo for the standard key (* < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001, **** < 0.0001).
findings.quote: We confirmed by lysosomal Oregon-green pH measurements that knockdown of TMED5 significantly enhanced lysosomal acidification in HsAPOE4 Neuro-2a cells, while not impacting the lysosomal density (Figure 5C-E)
findings.summary: (APOE4 + TMED5 knockdown) -> (lysosomal pH restored)
findings.system: Neuro-2a mouse neuroblastoma cells stably expressing human APOE3 or APOE4 (not human cells); isogenic apart from the APOE transgene. siRNA knockdown, Oregon-green lysosomal pH.

findings.description: Replication in human cells: APOE4 iPSC-derived neurons carry less lysosomal LGALS3BP and more lysosomal TMED5 than isogenic APOE3 neurons. Note: the published legend key is garbled ("*p < .05, ****p < .01, *p < .0001"); read as a typo for the standard key (* < 0.05, ** < 0.01, *** < 0.001, **** < 0.0001). Effect read off Fig 6B for LGALS3BP (about 55 vs 95 PLA intensity); lysosomal TMED5 about 1.7x higher.
findings.quote: we found that APOE4 iPSC-derived neurons harbored less lysosomal LGALS3BP and more lysosomal TMED5 compared to their APOE3 counterparts (Figure 6B,C)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (altered lysosomal protein composition in human neurons)
findings.system: Isogenic APOE3 vs APOE4 human iPSC-derived mixed neuronal cultures including GABAergic interneurons. Lysosomal proximity ligation assay against LAMP1.

findings.description: Lysosomal degradation activity is lower in APOE4/4 than APOE3/3 human iPSC-derived microglia at baseline (about 52 percent lower MFI; 5 APOE3/3 and 3 APOE4/4 iPSC lines, one dot per line).
findings.quote: we further analyzed lysosomal activity in iMGs using flow cytometry with an Abcam’s proprietary self-quenched substrate and found that E4/E4 iMGs exhibited significantly lower lysosomal degradation activity compared to E3/E3 cells (Fig. 1G-H)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less lysosomal degradation in microglia)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells from eight APOE3/3 and six APOE4/4 donor lines (population lines, not isogenic). Flow cytometry with a self-quenched lysosomal substrate, 1 h.

findings.description: Lysosomal membrane permeabilization after amyloid-beta exposure is greater in APOE4/4 microglia (more galectin puncta), i.e. leakier lysosomes.
findings.quote: the formation of galectin puncta, detected with galectin (LGALS)-1-specific antibody, was significantly higher in E4/E4 iMGs than in E3/E3 iMGs after Aβ42 exposure, indicating increased lysosomal leakage in E4/E4 iMGs
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4, with Abeta42) -> (more lysosomal membrane permeabilization)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells from eight APOE3/3 and six APOE4/4 donor lines (population lines, not isogenic). LGALS1 puncta imaging after Abeta42, 48 h.

findings.description: CONTRADICTING on the lipid arm: total cholesterol does not differ significantly by APOE genotype in these microglia (if anything APOE4/4 trends lower), confirmed by a second assay in a separate batch, so the lysosomal deficit here is not explained by higher cholesterol.
findings.quote: There was no significant APOE genotype effect on cholesterol levels, and this was confirmed using Amplex Red assay kit in a separate differentiation batch (Supplementary Fig. 3C)
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS the lipid arm: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in cellular cholesterol)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells from eight APOE3/3 and six APOE4/4 donor lines (population lines, not isogenic). Metabolomics plus Amplex Red cholesterol assay.

findings.description: CONTRADICTING on autophagy: basal LC3-II is lower in APOE4/4 microglia but autophagic flux with rapamycin and bafilomycin does not differ by genotype.
findings.quote: E4/E4 iMGs exhibit reduced basal levels of LC3-II but no significant differences in basal or rapamycin-induced autophagic flux, indicating that autophagy is not affected by the APOE genotype
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in autophagic flux)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells from eight APOE3/3 and six APOE4/4 donor lines (population lines, not isogenic). LC3-II/LC3-I western blot with rapamycin and bafilomycin.

findings.description: Lysosomal protein content trends lower in APOE4/4 microglia: LAMP-2 is reduced, and the lysosomal transporters MFSD1 and GLMP are downregulated in proteomics at baseline.
findings.quote: Since proteomic analysis comparing two (isogenic to each other) E4/E4 lines to E3/E3 lines revealed a downregulation of two other lysosomal proteins MFSD1 and GLMP in E4/E4 iMGs at basal conditions (Fig. 3B, Table S4), the overall lysosomal protein content may be reduced by E4/E4 genotype
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less lysosomal protein content)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived microglia-like cells from eight APOE3/3 and six APOE4/4 donor lines (population lines, not isogenic). Proteomics on an isogenic subset plus LAMP-2 western blot.

findings.description: Lipid droplets resist degradation in APOE4 astrocytes: BODIPY-C12 fatty acid persists longer in lipid droplets after a 24 h chase than in APOE2 astrocytes. Note: the P (0.0059) is for the 18-to-24 h decline within APOE2; the APOE4 decline is not significant (ns), so the comparison is a pattern difference, not a direct APOE4-vs-APOE2 test.
findings.quote: C12 fatty acids within lipid droplets persisted longer in APOE4 than in APOE2 astrocytes following a 24 h chase period under baseline conditions (Fig. 5D, E and Supplementary Fig.
findings.summary: (APOE2 -> APOE4) -> (slower lipid droplet turnover)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, APOE2 / APOE3 / APOE4 homozygous isogenic sets from two backgrounds (KOLF2.1J and line 325), oleic-acid loaded. BODIPY-C12 pulse-chase live imaging. Comparison is APOE4 vs APOE2, not vs APOE3.

findings.description: Lipophagy marker: the autophagy receptor p62 on lipid droplets is higher in APOE4 than in APOE3 or APOE2 astrocytes, consistent with droplets stalled in an autophagic route. Effect and P are APOE4 vs APOE3 (about 5.8 vs 3.35 percent of droplet volume; legend: APOE3-APOE4 p = 0.000038).
findings.quote: We observed by immunofluorescence that the levels of co-localized SQSTM1/p62 with lipid droplets were indeed higher in APOE4 than APOE2 astrocytes (Fig. 5B, C and Supplementary Fig.
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more p62 on lipid droplets -> stalled lipophagy)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, APOE2 / APOE3 / APOE4 homozygous isogenic sets from two backgrounds (KOLF2.1J and line 325), oleic-acid loaded. p62 and LipidSpot confocal colocalization, about 700 droplets per replicate.

findings.description: Proteome: the GO term autophagosome assembly is enriched among proteins found on APOE4 but not APOE2 lipid droplets, but it rests on three proteins (STBD1, MAP1LC3B, MAP1LC3B2) and does not survive multiple-testing correction (log q = 0 in Supplementary Data 13).
findings.quote: In contrast, proteins present on APOE4 lipid droplets but not found in APOE2 showed functional enrichment in protein secretion and autophagosome assembly pathways (Fig. 3B and Supplementary Data 12, 13)
findings.summary: (APOE2 -> APOE4) -> (autophagosome assembly proteins on lipid droplets)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, APOE2 / APOE3 / APOE4 homozygous isogenic sets from two backgrounds (KOLF2.1J and line 325), oleic-acid loaded. Buoyant-fraction lipid droplet proteomics.

findings.description: Lipid arm, with a caveat for the hypothesis: APOE4, APOE2 and APOE-knockout astrocytes all accumulate more lipid droplets than APOE3, so droplet number alone does not single out APOE4.
findings.quote: We recapitulate this finding and observe that APOE4, APOE2, and APOE-KO iPSC-derived astrocytes also accumulate lipid droplets relative to APOE3 (Supplementary Fig. S1C, D)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more lipid droplets), but APOE2 and KO do the same
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes, APOE2 / APOE3 / APOE4 homozygous isogenic sets from two backgrounds (KOLF2.1J and line 325), oleic-acid loaded. Lipid droplet staining and counting.

findings.description: Lipid cargo drives a lysosomal pathology in an isoform series: ApoE4 carrying polyunsaturated cholesteryl ester induces more neuronal lipofuscin than ApoE3 or ApoE2.
findings.quote: In human neurons, the addition of ApoE carrying polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs)-CE revealed an allelic series (ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2) associated with lipofuscinosis, an age-related lysosomal pathology resulting from lipid peroxidation
findings.summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4, same lipid cargo) -> (more lysosomal lipofuscin)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived NGN2 neurons treated with recombinant ApoE isoforms lipidated with POPC and the polyunsaturated cholesteryl ester CE(20:4); exogenous ApoE, not genotype. Longitudinal autofluorescence imaging at 7, 14 and 21 d.

findings.description: The APOE4-ApoE3 gap in lipofuscin widens with incubation time, matching the age-dependence built into the hypothesis: not significant at 7 d (Fig S5F, ns), about 54 percent higher with ApoE4 at 14 d (Fig S5G, ****), and still higher at 21 d (Fig 5B).
findings.quote: After longer incubation (14 d and 21 d), a progressively larger difference between ApoE4 and ApoE3 emerged (Figure S5G, Figure 5B)
findings.summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4) -> (lysosomal lipofuscin, growing with time)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived NGN2 neurons treated with recombinant ApoE isoforms lipidated with POPC and the polyunsaturated cholesteryl ester CE(20:4); exogenous ApoE, not genotype. Autofluorescence time course.

findings.description: The lipofuscin is lysosomal: it localizes to LAMP1-positive vesicles by super-resolution imaging.
findings.quote: Lipofuscin appeared mostly perikaryal and localized in LAMP1-positive lysosomes shown by super-resolution imaging (Figure 5C)
findings.summary: (ApoE4 + PUFA-CE) -> (lysosomal lipid deposit)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived NGN2 neurons treated with recombinant ApoE isoforms lipidated with POPC and the polyunsaturated cholesteryl ester CE(20:4); exogenous ApoE, not genotype. Super-resolution confocal with LAMP1.

findings.description: The effect needs the lipid: replacing the polyunsaturated cholesteryl ester with a monounsaturated one abolishes lipofuscin induction by ApoE4.
findings.quote: Replacing CE(20:4) with CE(18:1) in the POPC-ApoE4 lipoproteins abolished lipofuscin induction (Figure 5J-K), denoting a PUFA requirement
findings.summary: (ApoE4 with saturated cargo) -> (no lysosomal lipofuscin) -> lipid-dependent
findings.system: H4 neuroglioma cells treated with CE(20:4) or CE(18:1) lipidated ApoE4. Caveat: cell line, not neurons.

findings.description: Functional consequence: neurons loaded with the lipid-laden ApoE4 accumulate more internalized tau fibrils in endolysosomes, with the isoform order ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2. Effect and P are ApoE4 vs ApoE3 among lipofuscin-positive neurons (Fig 6I right, about 1.38 vs 1.12, **); across all neurons ApoE4 vs ApoE3 carries no mark (Fig 6I left).
findings.quote: total pHrodo signals from tau pffs that were internalized and accumulated in the endolysosomes demonstrated a trend of ApoE4 > ApoE3 > ApoE2 > K146E ApoE4, with the isoform-dependent difference being more pronounced among lipofuscin-positive neurons (Figure 6H-I)
findings.summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4, lipid cargo) -> (more undegraded tau in endolysosomes)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived NGN2 neurons treated with recombinant ApoE isoforms lipidated with POPC and the polyunsaturated cholesteryl ester CE(20:4); exogenous ApoE, not genotype. pHrodo-labeled tau preformed fibrils, 13-14 d after 14 d ApoE treatment.

findings.description: CONTRADICTING at maturity: at 18 days in vitro, lysosomal degradation of DQ-BSA does not differ between ApoE4, ApoE3 and ApoE knockout neurons; the APOE4 deficit appears only later, at 25-26 days (see P9.F2), so this is a null for young cultures rather than for the system.
findings.quote: When we compared our ApoE groups at 18 DIV there were no differences in the total intensities of DQ BSA in dendrites or cell bodies between ApoE KO, ApoE3, and ApoE4 neurons after 8 h (Fig. 2, G and H)
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS at 18 DIV: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4) -> (no change in lysosomal degradation)
findings.system: Primary mouse brain cultures (neurons with astrocytes) from human APOE knock-in mice: APOE knockout, APOE3 and APOE4. Mouse cells, not human. DQ-BSA 8 h, 18 DIV.

findings.description: With longer time in culture the deficit appears: at 25-26 DIV, DQ-BSA degradation in ApoE4 neuronal cell bodies is 21.9 percent lower than ApoE3.
findings.quote: remarkably the degradation of DQ BSA after 8 h was reduced with ApoE4, consistent with a significant reduction in DQ BSA integrated intensity in the cell bodies compared to ApoE3 (Fig. 4, F and G, 21.9%, p = 0.0495)
findings.summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4, aged culture) -> (less lysosomal degradation)
findings.system: Primary mouse brain cultures (neurons with astrocytes) from human APOE knock-in mice: APOE knockout, APOE3 and APOE4. Mouse cells, not human. DQ-BSA 8 h, 25-26 DIV.

findings.description: Fewer active acidic compartments in aged ApoE4 neurons: 19.8 percent fewer LysoTracker-positive vesicles and 35.6 percent lower LysoTracker intensity per cell body than ApoE3.
findings.quote: we detected a 19.8% lower number of LysoTracker positive vesicles (p = 0.011) and a 35.6% lower total LysoTracker intensity per neuronal cell body (p = 0.0059) in ApoE4 compared to ApoE3 neurons (Fig. 4, I-K)
findings.summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4, aged culture) -> (fewer active degradative compartments)
findings.system: Primary mouse brain cultures (neurons with astrocytes) from human APOE knock-in mice: APOE knockout, APOE3 and APOE4. Mouse cells, not human. Live LysoTracker high-content imaging, 25-26 DIV.

findings.description: CONTRADICTING on lysosome number: the number of LAMP1-positive late endosomes and lysosomes in neuronal cell bodies does not differ between genotypes even at 25-26 DIV, so the degradation deficit is functional rather than structural.
findings.quote: Although we did not detect significant differences in LAMP1+ vesicle number and size (Fig. 4, A-E) or trafficking of EGF to the cell body (Fig. S3W) between the ApoE isoforms at 25 to 26 DIV
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4) -> (no change in lysosome number or size)
findings.system: Primary mouse brain cultures (neurons with astrocytes) from human APOE knock-in mice: APOE knockout, APOE3 and APOE4. Mouse cells, not human. LAMP1 immunofluorescence, 25-26 DIV.

findings.description: Lipid arm, directly tested: when aged cultures are given cholesterol, ApoE4 neurons that accumulate it reach much higher endolysosomal (LAMP1-positive) cholesterol than ApoE3 or knockout, though only in about half the cultures.
findings.quote: Half of the time, similar to ApoE3 neurons, ApoE4 neurons accumulated very low amounts of cholesterol in endolysosomes (LAMP1+). Remarkably, however, when cholesterol did accumulate in ApoE4 neurons, it reached a considerably higher level than either ApoE KO or ApoE3 (Figs. 6, F, I, J and S4A)
findings.summary: (ApoE3 -> ApoE4, cholesterol load) -> (more cholesterol in late endosomes/lysosomes), variable
findings.system: Primary mouse brain cultures (neurons with astrocytes) from human APOE knock-in mice: APOE knockout, APOE3 and APOE4. Mouse cells, not human. Filipin puncta inside LAMP1 vesicles after 12.5 ug/ml cholesterol for 3 d, 25 DIV.

findings.description: CONTRADICTING on the lipid-to-lysosome step: after cholesterol loading, DQ-BSA degradation does not differ between APOE knockout, APOE3 and APOE4 neurons (Kruskal-Wallis p = 0.272; LAMP1 vesicle size likewise, Fig 6L, p = 0.334), so lipid load alone does not produce the APOE4-specific deficit.
findings.quote: Even though cholesterol seemed to have an impact on endosomes, including a lower number of early endosomes (Fig. 6K), larger LAMP1+ vesicles (Fig. 6L) without altering the number (Fig. S4E), and reduced degradation of DQ-BSA after 8 h (Fig. 6M), we detected similar changes between ApoE KO, ApoE3, and ApoE4
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS the mediation step: (cholesterol load) -> (lysosomal impairment) in every genotype alike
findings.system: Primary mouse brain cultures (neurons with astrocytes) from human APOE knock-in mice: APOE knockout, APOE3 and APOE4. Mouse cells, not human. DQ-BSA and LAMP1 after cholesterol supplementation, 25 DIV.

findings.description: With the lysosomal cholesterol exporter NPC1 blocked, APOE3 astrocytes clear neutral lipid out of neurons but APOE4 astrocytes do not. Effect: with NPC1 inhibition, about 74 vs 24 percent Nile Red-positive APOE3 neurons with APOE4 vs APOE3 astrocytes (Fig 1C).
findings.quote: In contrast, APOE4 hAs failed to mitigate neutral lipid accumulation (Fig. 1C and D)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4 astrocytes) -> (no clearance of lipid load imposed through the lysosome)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived neuron and astrocyte cocultures: CRISPR-edited APOE3, APOE4 or APOE-knockout human astrocytes plated with APOE3 or APOE4 neurons; lipid load induced with the NPC1 inhibitor U18666A. Nile Red staining of neuronal somas.
findings.location: Fig 1C-D (APOE3 vs APOE4 hAs under NPC1 inhibition)

findings.description: The same split for the downstream damage: APOE3 astrocytes reduce the neurite swellings caused by the lysosomal lipid load, APOE4 astrocytes do not, whatever the neuron genotype. Effect: with NPC1 inhibition, about 395 vs 190 GFP+ puncta along APOE3 neurites with APOE4 vs APOE3 astrocytes (Fig 4B).
findings.quote: However, regardless of neuronal APOE genotype, APOE3 hAs significantly reduced the number of GFP+ puncta induced by lipid stress, whereas APOE4 hAs did not (Fig. 4B)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4 astrocytes) -> (lipid-induced neurite damage not rescued)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived neuron and astrocyte cocultures: CRISPR-edited APOE3, APOE4 or APOE-knockout human astrocytes plated with APOE3 or APOE4 neurons; lipid load induced with the NPC1 inhibitor U18666A. GFP+ neurite puncta, live imaging.
findings.location: Fig 4B (APOE3 vs APOE4 hAs under NPC1 inhibition)

findings.description: Candidate lipid mechanism: HDL-like particles secreted into APOE3 cocultures are larger and more lipidated than in APOE4 cocultures. Effect: with NPC1 inhibition, large-particle band intensity about 0.8 with APOE4 vs 1.26 with APOE3 astrocytes, APOE3 neurons (Fig 5B).
findings.quote: This difference became more pronounced under lipid challenge, as APOE3 astrocyte cocultures significantly increased large extracellular particle levels in response to NPC1 inhibition, while APOE4 cocultures did not show a similar response (Fig. 5A and B)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no increase in large, lipidated ApoE particles under lipid load)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived neuron and astrocyte cocultures: CRISPR-edited APOE3, APOE4 or APOE-knockout human astrocytes plated with APOE3 or APOE4 neurons; lipid load induced with the NPC1 inhibitor U18666A. Sizing of extracellular HDL-like particles in coculture media.

findings.description: CONTRADICTING for neuron-intrinsic APOE: in neurons alone, the cholesterol accumulation (filipin) produced by NPC1 inhibition is the same in APOE3 and APOE4 neurons.
findings.quote: In iN alone, NPC1 inhibition significantly increased both the percentage of filipin+ neurons and the number of filipin+ particles per soma in APOE3 and APOE4 iNs compared with Veh, with no significant difference between APOE genotypes (Fig. 2A-C)
findings.summary: CONTRADICTS in neurons alone: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in lysosomal cholesterol load)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived APOE3 or APOE4 neurons without astrocytes; filipin imaging after NPC1 inhibition.

findings.description: APOE4 astrocytes accumulate more lipid droplets than APOE3 astrocytes, with more of the droplet protein perilipin-2.
findings.quote: After 2 weeks in culture, we observed that APOE4 astrocytes accumulated a greater number of lipid droplets than did their APOE3 counterparts (Fig. 1E), which was accompanied by accumulation of a lipid droplet-resident protein, Perilipin-2 (Fig. 1F) (32)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more lipid droplets)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes from APOE4 and APOE3 carriers (fibroblast-derived, population lines), plus yeast expressing human APOE isoforms. BODIPY lipid droplet staining and perilipin-2 western blot, 2 weeks in culture.

findings.description: The triacylglycerols stored in APOE4 astrocytes are more unsaturated than in APOE3: the APOE4/APOE3 fold change rises from about 1.5 for saturated species to about 6 for species with nine double bonds, the composition that makes them prone to peroxidation.
findings.quote: We also observed that the degree of unsaturation of the fatty acids attached to triacylglycerides in APOE4 astrocytes was far higher than that in APOE3 astrocytes (Fig. 1D)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more unsaturated stored triacylglycerol)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes from APOE4 and APOE3 carriers (fibroblast-derived, population lines), plus yeast expressing human APOE isoforms. LC-MS whole-cell lipidomics.

findings.description: The lipid disruption is reversible by a phospholipid precursor: choline supplementation restores the APOE4 astrocyte lipidome, showing the defect is metabolic rather than fixed.
findings.quote: APOE4-expressing astrocytes treated with CDP-choline showed a decrease in lipid droplet number to that found in APOE3-expressing astrocytes (Fig. 4D)
findings.summary: (APOE4 + CDP-choline) -> (lipid droplets back to APOE3 level)
findings.system: Human iPSC-derived astrocytes from APOE4 and APOE3 carriers (fibroblast-derived, population lines), plus yeast expressing human APOE isoforms. CDP-choline supplementation then lipid droplet imaging and lipidomics.

findings.description: Cellular cholesterol by filipin III is higher in APOE4 than isogenic APOE3 astrocytes, quantified per cell by flow cytometry.
findings.quote: We next used flow cytometry analysis to better quantify the filipin III signal in individual cells, finding higher average fluorescent intensity in APOE4 compared to APOE3 astrocytes (Figure 3F)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more cellular cholesterol)
findings.system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes: APOE4/4 line CRISPR-edited from the APOE3/3 iPSCs of an unaffected donor. Filipin III flow cytometry. Lipid readout only in this panel.

findings.description: Lysosome-dependent degradation of amyloid-beta is reduced in APOE4 astrocytes: blocking lysosomes raises intracellular Abeta42 in APOE3 but much less in APOE4, implying APOE4 lysosomes were degrading less to begin with.
findings.quote: We observed increased Aβ42 accumulation following lysosome inhibition in APOE3 astrocytes compared to APOE4 astrocytes, suggesting reduced lysosome-dependent Aβ42 degradation in APOE4 astrocytes (Figure S3D)
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (less lysosome-dependent degradation of cargo)
findings.system: Isogenic human iPSC-derived astrocytes: APOE4/4 line CRISPR-edited from the APOE3/3 iPSCs of an unaffected donor. Abeta42 uptake with lysosomal inhibition, then intracellular Abeta42 measurement.

findings.description: APOE4 accumulates in enlarged lysosomes and late endosomes and changes autophagic flux, lysosomal protein content and lipid droplets.
findings.quote: We found, by examining cells stably expressing each APOE isoform, that APOE4 increases lysosomal trafficking, accumulates in enlarged lysosomes and late endosomes, alters autophagic flux and the abundance of autophagy proteins and lipid droplets, and alters the proteomic contents of lysosomes following internalization
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (enlarged late endosomes/lysosomes, altered autophagic flux and lipid droplets)
findings.system: HEK293 and HepG2 cell lines stably expressing mCherry-tagged APOE3 or APOE4, plus mouse brain tissue. Not human brain cells: included because it tests the lysosomal handling of APOE itself. Confocal imaging of APOE-mCherry with LAMP1-GFP (Fig 3A); the quote is the abstract summary and also covers autophagy and proteomic panels elsewhere in the paper.

findings.description: Lysosomes exposed to APOE4 lose mitochondrial proteins such as prohibitin from their contents, linking the lysosomal change to mitochondrial turnover. Supplementary Fig S7 legend: lysosome proteomics by ANOVA, n = 4 samples per group, significance p < 0.05.
findings.quote: Proteins reduced in APOE4 lysosomes that were not reduced in mCh-treated cells included mitochondrial proteins such as prohibitin
findings.summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (altered lysosomal proteome, less mitochondrial cargo)
findings.system: HepG2 cells treated 24 h with APOE3 or APOE4 conditioned medium; lysosome immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry. Caveat: hepatic cell line.
